To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
‘trust in Airbnb.com’ is a prerequisite for a provider to initiate a sharing deal with a renter.

‘Trust in Airbnb’ is a significant predictor of ‘trust in renters’ and both trust constructs have significant positive effects on the provider’s willingness to share and the intention to recommend the platform to others.
‘trust in Airbnb.com’ is the most important antecedent of trust in a sharing deal and that ‘trust in renters’ is the main antecedent of the intention to rent again.
In summary, our research is concerned with
trust as a key concept in the sharing economy and contributes to the literature on the sharing economy by providing insights on the antecedents of trust in this context.
the role of trust in a C2C sharing economy.
the antecedents and consequences of trust, which is a crucial concept for the sharing economy.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the trust concept in the sharing economy is more complex and has a greater impact on the provider than previously assumed.
the sharing economy is not just another online market place.
the trust constructs ‘Trust in Airbnb’ and ‘Trust to Renters’ are decisive to successfully initiating a sharing deal between providers and renters.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
trust is a crucial antecedent for a provider’s decision to share his or her accommodation.
trust is a crucial antecedent in the sharing economy, and that it has to be fostered by Airbnb.com to ensure the sustainability of the business model.
trust is a crucial antecedent to the sharing economy, as it enables the formation of temporary relationships.
The main takeaway from our work is that
trust in the sharing industry differs from other online industries.
the sharing economy requires a new conceptualization of trust and its antecedents.
trust is a critical success factor for sharing economies, which is a new phenomenon in the context of C2C relationships.
